method: Fresh code-drawn text/shapes based on exact official-product photographs. No product photograph pixels, crop or vector original used.
scope: Printed labels on fixed native shell only. No geometry, control, LED, cable, Port or component API changes.
limits: Colours, typography, dimensions and alignment are reconstructed from product photographs and native label recesses, not production-print data.
Printed channel 0 is at bottom CH0 (API control 1), and printed 7 at top CH7 (API control 8). Rear table repeats official printed schematic annotations and is not a firmware or wiring implementation.
No exhaustive browser pixel inspection; necessary support/geometry/control/Grove smoke only.
rights: Product marks and original printed designs retain their respective rights. These are reference reconstructions, not official production artwork.
